### Hexcel Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 1, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/180688177/files/doc_news/Hexcel-Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


STAMFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Hexcel Corporation (NYSE: HXL) announced today that it will report financial results for its third quarter of 2026 on Wednesday, October 21 after the market close.


The company will host a webcast and conference call to discuss highlights of its financial results on Thursday, October 22 at 9:30 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Chairman, CEO and President Tom Gentile and Chief Financial Officer Jamie Coogan.


The event will be webcast via the[Investor Relations webpage](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F512023355&esheet=54610235&newsitemid=20261001266013&lan=en-US&anchor=Investor+Relations+webpage&index=1&md5=005d97be2839287613eabcaa7653d06c) at[www.Hexcel.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.Hexcel.com&esheet=54610235&newsitemid=20261001266013&lan=en-US&anchor=www.Hexcel.com&index=2&md5=c6568e8f3996080e8d0b4346b616dd08) . The event can also be accessed by dialing +1 (585)-542-9983. The conference ID is 512 023 355. A replay of the call will be available on the investor relations page of the Hexcel website approximately two hours after the conclusion of the call.


**About Hexcel**


[Hexcel Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hexcel.com&esheet=54610235&newsitemid=20261001266013&lan=en-US&anchor=Hexcel+Corporation&index=3&md5=ca7831bd890a2142fc29ec4f3a7fbedd) is a global leader in advanced lightweight composites technology. We provide innovative, high-performance material solutions that are lighter, stronger and tougher, shaping a world that moves farther, smarter and more efficiently. Our broad and unrivaled product range includes carbon fiber, specialty reinforcements, prepregs and other fiber-reinforced matrix materials, honeycomb, resins, engineered core, and composite structures for use in commercial aerospace, defense and space, and industrial applications.
